spec: Doc 09 FR-21 / Doc 06 NFR-06 — consumer contracts for Doc 09's NON-ticket durable consumption (S09 step 9; ADR 0011). The ticket.* slices live in fixtures/tickets/consumers/doc09.json.
note: Every consumer reads identifiers only and re-fetches content under its own tenancy (SEC-07/Q7). ClassifyInboundMessage reads message_id and consults BatchTailHint (EC-01) — the body is re-read from the messages row. The media consumers read message_id + index + storage_key and write transcript_ref/ocr_ref back to the media item.
